stories.title: Studente 14enne pianifica un'aggressione con un coltello contro la prof, fermato dai carabinieri

en.title: 14-year-old student plans knife attack on teacher, stopped by carabinieri
en.summary: A 14-year-old organized an attack against a teacher through a Telegram group and hid a weapon in school bathrooms. Classmates prevented the assault from occurring.

stories.title: “L’estranea” di Paolo Strippoli scelto per rappresentare l’Italia nella corsa agli Oscar

en.title: "L'Estranea" by Paolo Strippoli chosen to represent Italy in Oscar race
en.summary: Paolo Strippoli's film "L'Estranea" has been selected as Italy's official submission for the Academy Awards. The film releases in theaters on October 8.

stories.title: L'Estranea di Strippoli designato a rappresentare l'Italia agli Oscar

en.title: L'Estranea by Strippoli designated to represent Italy at the Oscars
en.summary: Paolo Strippoli's film "L'Estranea" has been designated as Italy's official entry for the Academy Awards.

stories.title: Chi era Andrea Moretti, l'operaio che ha perso la vita sul Colosseo

en.title: Who was Andrea Moretti, the worker who died on the Colosseum
en.summary: Andrea Moretti, a 22-year-old expert rock climber from the Teramo province, died while working on the Colosseum. He was recognized for his professional skills despite his young age.

stories.title: Andrea Moretti, chi era l’operaio morto al Colosseo: la passione per i cavalli e la montagna

en.title: Andrea Moretti, who was the worker who died at the Colosseum: his passion for horses and mountains
en.summary: A 22-year-old worker from Teramo province died at the Colosseum while working on the monument. He was a rock climber known for his cheerful disposition and left behind his parents and three sisters.

stories.title: Operaio morto al Colosseo, Procura indaga per omicidio colposo

en.title: Worker dead at Colosseum, Prosecutor investigates for manslaughter
en.summary: Authorities are investigating the death of the worker at the Colosseum for possible manslaughter. An autopsy has been ordered and carabinieri will acquire relevant documents.

stories.title: L’Estranea, l’horror di Paolo Strippoli rappresenterà l’Italia nella corsa agli Oscar

en.title: L'Estranea, Paolo Strippoli's horror film will represent Italy in the Oscar race
en.summary: An Italian horror film has been selected to compete for an Academy Award nomination. The official shortlist will be announced on December 15, with the final selection revealed on January 21.

stories.title: Lamezia Terme, alunno pianifica aggressione con coltello alla prof: fermato dai carabinieri

en.title: Lamezia Terme, student plans knife attack against teacher: arrested by carabinieri
en.summary: A 14-year-old middle school student was arrested after planning an attack on a teacher. Authorities discovered a Telegram group connected to the planned incident.

stories.title: Andrea Moretti, il rocciatore morto a 22 anni sul Colosseo: i cavalli, l’Abruzzo, il mestiere del padre

en.title: Andrea Moretti, the climber who died at 22 on the Colosseum: horses, Abruzzo, his father's profession
en.summary: A 22-year-old specialized worker from Teramano died in a work accident. His father had previously left the same profession after a serious injury, and local authorities described the young man as cheerful and devoted to his region and animals.

stories.title: Incidente sul lavoro al Colosseo: morto un operaio di 22 anni

en.title: Work accident at the Colosseum: 22-year-old worker dies
en.summary: Andrea Moretti fell from scaffolding while working on lighting installation at the Colosseum. Authorities launched a manslaughter investigation and closed the archaeological site.

stories.title: Operaio di 22 anni muore al Colosseo: indagine per omicidio colposo. Giuli ordina la chiusura

en.title: 22-year-old worker dies at Colosseum: manslaughter investigation opened. Giuli orders closure
en.summary: Specialist climber Andrea Moretti fell approximately ten meters from height during work on new lighting installation. An autopsy was ordered and the remains were transferred to the legal medicine institute.

stories.title: A 14 anni pianifica su Telegram di accoltellare la prof a scuola: fermato dai carabinieri

en.title: At 14, plans via Telegram to stab teacher at school: stopped by carabinieri
en.summary: A 14-year-old was detained after allegedly planning a stabbing attack on a teacher through messaging app communications, apparently mimicking a similar incident by another minor.

stories.title: Fs lancia i nuovi Intercity per collegare anche le aree più svantaggiate

en.title: Fs launches new Intercity trains to connect disadvantaged areas
en.summary: Italian railway operator Fs is launching new Alstom Intercity 200 trains as part of a 500 million euro investment plan to improve connectivity in underserved regions.

stories.title: Il World Tourism Event di Assisi celebra i siti Unesco come strumento di dialogo e conoscenza reciproca

en.title: World Tourism Event in Assisi celebrates UNESCO sites as tools for dialogue and mutual understanding
en.summary: An event in Assisi highlights the role of UNESCO World Heritage sites in promoting cultural exchange and knowledge sharing, marking nearly 50 years since Italy's first site was recognized.

stories.title: Mediaworld, al via il piano d’investimenti da 200 milioni al 2030

en.title: Mediaworld launches 200 million euro investment plan through 2030
en.summary: Electronics retailer Mediaworld is investing 200 million euros by 2030 to expand its territorial presence and strengthen its omnichannel capabilities as it marks 35 years operating in Italy.

stories.title: Via a nuovo polo genovese per la manutenzione di barche fino a 30 metri

en.title: New Genoese hub launches for maintenance of boats up to 30 meters
en.summary: A new production facility dedicated to maintenance, renovation, and servicing of sailboats and motorboats up to 30 meters in length has been established in Genoa.

stories.title: Secondary ticketing, 10 anni dopo: com’è cambiata l’industria dei concerti

en.title: Secondary ticketing, 10 years later: how the concert industry has changed
en.summary: A decade after online ticket reselling became a major issue in 2016, the live music market has undergone significant transformations through new regulations and industry restructuring.
